_comment: Every generation the north-south cars ran, in order. init_image_strength is how much of the
guide the model keeps (higher is closer). The wrecks were not generated: guides/wreck.py damages
the kept intact sheet, the shared generation budget having gone on the bodies.

generations.why: kept the guide almost pixel for pixel: flat, no texture, nothing the pack's cars have that the guide lacked
generations.description: three parked cars seen from above and behind, nose pointing up/north, top-down 3/4 game sprites side by side: faded teal compact hatchback, dusty cream delivery van with two rear doors, olive pickup truck with open empty cargo bed; roof and rear visible, blue-gray glass windshield, red tail lights, black tyres, chunky near-black stepped outline, broad flat pixels, 3-4 tones per material, muted desaturated colors, sparse wear

generations.why: the three intact cars: the pack's worn paint and dust, glass with a reflection, the guide's geometry kept
generations.description: three parked cars seen from above and behind, nose pointing up/north, top-down 3/4 game sprites side by side: faded teal compact hatchback, dusty cream delivery van with two rear doors, olive pickup truck with open empty cargo bed; roof and rear visible, blue-gray glass windshield, red tail lights, black tyres, chunky near-black stepped outline, broad flat pixels, 3-4 tones per material, muted desaturated colors, sparse wear, scuffs and panel seams
